// Fishing championship scenarios, run by both FishChampProbe.java and
// oracle_test.go. Steps:
//   start <instant>          the clock at boot
//   memo <instant>           the stored week end (server_memo)
//   row <name> <len> <rew>   a stored fishing_championship row
//   boot                     restore and start
//   fish <name> <lure> <rolls...>  a catch, each roll the dice's draw
//   mid                      the fishing window's ranking button
//   champ                    a fisherman's FishingChampionship page
//   reward <name>            a fisherman's FishingReward
//   advance <instant>        let the clock run to instant
//   restart                  save, then restore and start anew
//   rows                     save, then print the stored rows (last step
//                            before restart or the next scenario)
